plugin.name: tilt-move
plugin._long: While a window is dragged, it turns in 3D perspective following the motion and springs back flat when it stops, in the style of the Compiz Fusion 3D tilt. Works with the move plugin (and together with wobbly).

option.name: strength
option._long: Tilt in degrees per 1000 pixels per second of motion.

option.name: response
option._long: How quickly the tilt follows the motion and springs back, per second (higher = snappier).

option.name: invert
option._long: Lean the other way: the leading edge goes back instead of the trailing edge.
